name: Command uploads a credential file
description: A curl or wget command in this text reads as one that sends a credential file, or the whole environment, to a remote address: the payload word names the file, reads standard input that carries it through filters that pass it on, or takes it from a substitution or an expanding here-document. In a file or message text, a command that follows a warning word or sits inside a fenced block is a notice, not a verdict.
